SELECT * FROM DEV_BRONCE_CARS_PROPERTIES.CP_STG.T_METADATA
WHERE
1=1
AND INGESTION_NAME = '1.INGESTION-TO-PROD'
AND ACTIVE = TRUE
;

text.value:
@concat(
  'USE DATABASE ', json(item().TARGET).database, '; ',
  'USE SCHEMA ',   json(item().TARGET).schema,   '; ',
  'MERGE INTO ',
    json(item().TARGET).database, '.', json(item().TARGET).schema, '.', json(item().TARGET).table, ' AS T
USING (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      d.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY d.MATRICULA
        ORDER BY COALESCE(d.T_REC_UPD_TST, d.T_REC_INS_TST, TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(0)) DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM ',
      json(item().SOURCE).database, '.', json(item().SOURCE).schema, '.', json(item().SOURCE).table, ' d
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
) AS S
ON T.', json(item().MERGE_KEYS).condition, ' = S.', json(item().MERGE_KEYS).condition, '
WHEN MATCHED
  AND COALESCE(T.', json(item().DEDUPE_ORDER).update, ', T.', json(item().DEDUPE_ORDER).insert, ', TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(0))
      < COALESCE(S.', json(item().DEDUPE_ORDER).update, ', S.', json(item().DEDUPE_ORDER).insert, ', TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(0))
THEN UPDATE SET
  T.DNI_PROPIETARIO   = S.DNI_PROPIETARIO,
  T.MARCA_VEHICULO    = S.MARCA_VEHICULO,
  T.PROVINCIA         = S.PROVINCIA,
  T.FECHA_PROPIETARIO = S.FECHA_PROPIETARIO,
  T.T_REC_INS_TST     = S.T_REC_INS_TST,
  T.T_REC_UPD_TST     = S.T_REC_UPD_TST
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
  INSERT (MATRICULA, DNI_PROPIETARIO, MARCA_VEHICULO, PROVINCIA, 
          FECHA_PROPIETARIO, T_REC_INS_TST, T_REC_UPD_TST)
  VALUES (S.MATRICULA, S.DNI_PROPIETARIO, S.MARCA_VEHICULO, S.PROVINCIA, 
          S.FECHA_PROPIETARIO, S.T_REC_INS_TST, S.T_REC_UPD_TST);'
)
